improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
improve.coach: It's crept up to 80% of your recent matches (60% overall). Let's make it the focus.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
improve.coach: 40% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

improve.title: Playing forward
tips: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
improve.coach: Steady at about 33% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it. Shows up in 73% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: Always available, always an option. There in 53% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed. 47% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

coach.intro: BellyTb1, I've watched all 15 of your matches. Here's what the tape and the numbers are telling me.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
